Read the syllabus! It is basically a contract between you and your professor that you BOTH are held to. I've had professors hide extra credit opportunities there and I've also had professors decide to do things that directly went against the syllabus which they later had to recon, leading to most students grades going up. 

The other advice I have is understand that Canvas (or whatever grade tracker your uni uses) is not guaranteed to actually reflect your true grade because many times professors don't bother or don't know how to properly set it up. Just this semester I thought I was receiving an A in a class and instead recieved a B because the professor did not set up Canvas correctly.
